sentence: This project brings together researchers to discuss the security threats and opportunities of quantum computing.
This project improves access to advanced research networks for smaller and less resourced institutions.
This project builds soft neural implants made by three-dimensional printing to match each individual brain structure.
This project applies methods from cybersecurity, data analytics and machine learning to problems in computational sciences and engineering.
This project uses machine learning to find faint echoes from a thin layer just above the core of the planet and make a global map.
This project studies how to store binary information in composite DNA letters so that storage is cost-effective and reliable.
This project develops methods to learn the underlying structure of datasets with missing data and to verify whether it is correct.
This project studies how to treat security as a fundamental system design attribute.
This project explores how organic carbon and nitrogen are generated and degraded in seafloor hydrothermal systems and how minerals and metals change them.
This project studies how brain structure and brain function change together as the visual system of children develops from infancy to young adulthood.
This project builds robots with a color-changing gel coating that shows forces, so they can perceive and handle soft and fragile objects without damage.
This project focuses on protecting connected embedded systems, such as baby monitors and smart cars, from hackers.
This project builds computational fluid dynamics software that runs on quantum computers and tests it on aircraft noise reduction.
This project creates squeezed light sources in integrated photonic chips and uses them for precision measurement with less quantum noise.
This project develops methods to learn graph structures from single-cell RNA sequencing data and infer gene regulatory networks.
This project studies how gene expression relates to the development of male and female flowers in maples and compares maples with other plants.
This project develops control algorithms that keep autonomous systems safe even when their onboard computing is limited.
This project studies how motile bacteria move at liquid crystal interfaces and how those interfaces can control their flows.
